results.title: SoonLab 2.0 enables 3D game creation through natural-language AI agents | Dealroom.co
highlights: SoonLab has launched SoonLab 2.0, its next-generation AI-powered game creation platform. The New York City-based company announced the update on 15 August. The new model enables creators to build playable 3D games using natural language, expanding beyond the previous 2D capabilities. SoonLab 2.0 introduces an agent-guided workflow that asks follow-up questions and confirms creative requirements through conversation before generating games. The platform allows users to describe game concepts in a single sentence, then modify results through natural-language dialogue with the AI agent. The system aims to help creators translate game ideas into playable prototypes without coding, reducing trial and error in the development process. The conversational approach means the AI clarifies gameplay mechanics, rules, interactions, difficulty, and visual behaviour before starting creation, producing more accurate initial results.
